dct_description_sm: This dataset records water quality of several watersheds - Ancaster Creek, Bronte Creek, Tiffany Creek, Sulfur Springs Creek, and Spencer Creek, all of which feed into Cootes Paradise - as part of the Redeemer University water quality monitoring project. This ongoing monitoring program is designed to track water quality parameters over time. The dataset includes measures of nitrate and nitrite, phosphate, total phosphorus, E. coli and total coliforms. For more regular, ongoing and comprehensive water quality monitoring data concerning the Chedoke Creek Watershed, which also feeds into Cootes Paradise, see https://doi.org/10.25976/29km-wu94.
dct_title_s: Other Watersheds Feeding into Cootes Paradise Water Quality Monitoring Data
